question: On stocks that are IN PLAY at the minute (fast-moving right now), does RSI-2 red - bought mid-bar as it appears, or at the next open after it closes red - beat OTHER in-play stocks at the same minute over 1-5 minutes and on the desk's exit?
what was seen before writing this (discl: all RSI-2 red variants on the full ~400-name universe = same-minute peers (rsi2_colour_timing, persistence, htf, washout, approach); gross 0-1.7 bp
the operator's winning examples (BE, WDC, ON, CBRS on 11/16-18) were fast movers; Neon (11/21) flagged universe dilution; Neon's prior for this test 10-15%
volatility was never used as a selector in the RSI-2 tests; SEARCH outcomes of red starts are known only in aggregate. CONFIRM 2026-09-24..11-18 minus 11/16-18 unopened
in play (known at the signal minute): the name's mean 1-minute range (high - low) / close over the 15 completed minutes before the signal bar, in the TOP DECILE of all universe names with a value at that same minute (cross-sectional, so a quiet day does not empty the set); information: top quintile
no climax: mid-bar entries: bar t-1's range <= 1.5 x the name's 15-minute mean range; bar-close entries: the red bar t's range <= 1.5 x that mean

rules (2 scored).S (mid-bar): the parent RED_STOP entry (exact trigger, fresh cross, P > close[t-1], below SMA200; buy-stop fill inside bar t) on an in-play, no-climax name
rules (2 scored).C (bar close): a closed red start (bar t red, t-1 not), in play and no climax at t; buy the open of t+1

peers (primary control): up to 5 OTHER in-play names at the same minute (same decile rule), with the same entry type (same-distance buy-stop for S, the same open for C) and the same exits - this isolates red from 'fast stocks move more'
names, window, refractory: ~400 by prior-day dollar volume (ETFs excluded), $20-$400, no day filter, entries 09:45-15:30; per rule per name until the ratchet exit and >= 15 minutes
exits: close of the 1st / 3rd / 5th minute counting the entry minute; the parent's approximate desk ratchet

step 1 (SEARCH only; CONFIRM counts only.gate: a rule passes on ANY ONE of the 3-minute, 5-minute or ratchet exits: lift vs in-play peers > 0 in both halves, pooled day t >= 1.0, each half's MDE <= 10 bp, pooled lift >= +3 bp, pooled gross >= +5 bp on ALL exits counted (in-play moves are larger, so the cost bar is the spread: gross >= +5 bp), same-name-later lift >= 0; 6 looks, disclosed
step 1 (SEARCH only; CONFIRM counts only.information: top-quintile version; lift vs ALL same-minute names (not only in-play); share of the operator's 11/16-18 examples that count as in play

step 2 (only if the gate passes): live-exit replay on SIP prints; CONFIRM lift > 0 with day t >= 2.0 and >= 300 signals; PROFITABLE: net >= +2 bp both halves after the real SIP spread (in-play spreads are wider - the 15 bp entry gate applies)
fail: anything short of step 2's pass; then RSI-2 red is CLOSED as an entry signal (operator 11/21)
checks: unit tests: the 15-minute range uses completed bars only; the decile is per minute across names; climax rule; peers are in-play at the same minute
examples (signals only): BE 2026-11-17 ~10:55 and WDC 2026-11-18 ~11:58 should be in play
